| Windows (portable) | `ClowderAI-X.Y.Z.zip` | Extract and replace old folder |

## Upgrading

**In-app update (recommended):** The desktop app checks for updates at startup and shows a dialog when this version is available. Click **Download** to upgrade automatically.

**Manual upgrade:** Download the installer/DMG above and run it over the existing installation. Your data (threads, memories, configuration) is preserved.

**If an update fails:** The downloaded installer is saved at a fixed location — you can rerun it without opening the app:
- **Windows**: `%LOCALAPPDATA%\Clowder AI\updates\`
- **macOS**: `~/Library/Application Support/Clowder AI/updates/`

On next app launch, a recovery dialog will also appear with retry and diagnostic options.
